name: zinput_bindmap_current_set_command_callback
description: Forwards a command callback registration to the current input bind-map context.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInput bind-map source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4717c0 pushes the fastcall callback and command id, loads g_zInput_BindMap_Current, and calls zInput_BindMapContext::SetCommandCallback. The native bind-map smoke validates wrapper dispatch through the active current context and the keyboard callback side effects.
